'''Izar''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who served as representative among the [[Outreach Bureau|Imperial Outreach Division]]. Shortly before the [[Dantooine Incursion]], Izar contacted [[Lana Beniko]] to get in touch with the Commander of the [[Eternal Alliance]].

==Personality==
Izar was a quite charismatic [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who often showered his conversation partners with compliments.
He also held the traditional ways of the Empire in a quite high esteem.<ref name="Heartsandminds" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Greetings, Commander! So good of you to contact me. I serve within the Imperial Outreach Division. Specifically, I seek out opportunities to inspire greatness among our noble frontline soldiers. Darth Krovos is giving a speech to our forces gathered at Vaiken Spacedock in preparation for their deployment. This could be an opportunity to say a few words of your own. Your actions have made you a living legend, after all. Certainty of victory inspires confidence. Hearing that you are out there, fighting the same fight they are, will undoubtedly instill that confidence in our troops.|Izar to the Commander of the [[Eternal Alliance]]|<ref name="Heartsandminds" />}}
Izar contacts [[Alliance Commander|The Commander]] if the player is [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]].
